summary: Mindwendel is a web application designed for team collaboration, specifically focusing on collecting and voting on ideas. It provides a centralised space where users can submit thoughts and prioritise them through an upvoting mechanism.
goodFor: Teams looking for a dedicated, self-hosted tool to facilitate internal brainstorming sessions and lightweight feature prioritisation without relying on commercial SaaS.
watchOut: The project has a low maintenance score and a modest repository star count, indicating that it may lack active support or community contributions for long-term deployments.
deployNotes: As a containerised Elixir application distributed via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for your data, set up environment variables, and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
